evidence: Vulg. Joh. 1.46: ā Nāzareth potest aliquid bonī esse? (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Indeclinable; the Vulgate gives it a preposition, as in ā Nāzareth. Also Nāzara, Nāzarae f. (Juvencus). The adjective is Nazarēnus, of Nazareth (Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: A Nāzareth potest aliquid bonī esse?
phrases.english: Can anything good come out of Nazareth?

sources: Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections, checked against the editions named there.
